div.div:
1 قَرَظَهُ , aor.
قَرِظَ , inf. n. قَرْظٌ, He tanned it, (Msb, TA,) namely, a skin, or hide, (Msb,) or a skin for water or milk, (TA,) with قَرَظ, q. v. infra: (Msb, TA:) or he dyed it therewith. (TA.) ―
-b2- He plucked it, or gathered it, from the tree; namely, what is called قَرَظ. (Msb.) ＝
-A2- قَرَظْتُهُ a dial. var. of قَرَضْتُهُ, in the phrase قَرَظْتُهُ ذَاتَ الشِّمَالِ, q. v. (Fr, K.) ―
-b2- And [in like manner as a dial. var. of قَرَضْتُهُ,] I cut it, or made it and cut it according to a measure and pattern. (Fr.) ＝
-A3- قَرِظَ, aor.
قَرَظَ , He was, or became, a lord, master, chief, or man of rank or quality, after being in a base or abject state. (IAar, O, K; and T in art. قرض.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
